milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate close enough to the red stained glass windows on the front wall and be facing toward them to confirm visual identification. Target is the center of the 2x2 glass window cluster on the front wall at spawn-relative (6, 2, 5). max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable viewing distance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the glass.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate near the nether brick structure and face it. Target is the center of the structure at spawn-relative (6, 2, 8). max_distance=16 allows detection from a comfortable viewing range, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the nether brick walls. The entire structure is nether bricks so any approach angle toward the center works.

Uses inventory_has because mining a torch causes it to drop as an item that enters the player's inventory. Wall torches drop as regular 'torch' items (confirmed by CommonSenseAgent). The player starts with no torches, so any torch in inventory proves successful mining. min_count=1 since the player only needs to mine one of the four available torches.
